movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability. This may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to bypass the patch developed for the symbolic link persistency mechanism observed in some post-exploit cases, via crafted HTTP requests. An attacker would need first to have compromised the product via another vulnerability, at filesystem level.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Defender Link Following Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Defender contains a link following vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System Driver contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could allow a threat actor for privileges escalation

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Prototype Pollution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple Safari, iOS, watchOS, visionOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow the processing of maliciously crafted web content which may lead to memory corruption.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Skia Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Skia contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco SD-WAN Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco SD-WAN CLI contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to gain elevated privileges via improper access controls on commands within the application CLI. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as the root user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Soliton Systems K.K FileZen OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Soliton Systems K.K FileZen contains an OS command injection vulnerability when an user logs-in to the affected product and sends a specially crafted HTTP request.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Motex LANSCOPE Endpoint Manager Improper Verification of Source of a Communication Channel Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Motex LANSCOPE Endpoint Manager contains an improper verification of source of a communication channel vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending specially crafted packets.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Samsung Mobile Devices Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Samsung mobile devices contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libimagecodec.quram.so which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-Central Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: N-able N-Central contains a command injection vulnerability via improper sanitization of user input.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium ANGLE and GPU Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium contains an improper input validation vulnerability in ANGLE and GPU. This vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability leading to unintended control flow and Denial of Service. NetScaler must be configured as Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) OR AAA virtual server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Scripting Engine Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Scripting Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network via a specially crafted URL.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Partner Center Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Partner Center contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Power Pages Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Power Pages contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network potentially bypassing the user registration control.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Craft CMS Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability caused by improper validation of the database backup path, ultimately enabling remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain an unspecified vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: ScienceLogic SL1 Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ScienceLogic SL1 (formerly EM7) is affected by an unspecified vulnerability involving an unspecified third-party component.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains an unspecified vulnerability in the ExternalInterface ActionScript functionality that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted SWF content.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability in the Firefox sandbox that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted SWF content.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Kingsoft WPS Office Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Kingsoft WPS Office contains a path traversal vulnerability in promecefpluginhost.exe on Windows that allows an attacker to load an arbitrary Windows library.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Project Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Project contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via a malicious file.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Memory Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an unspecified out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and Safari WebKit contain a type confusion vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Spreadsheet::ParseExcel Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Spreadsheet::ParseExcel contains a remote code execution vulnerability due to passing unvalidated input from a file into a string-type “eval”. Specifically, the issue stems from the evaluation of Number format strings within the Excel parsing logic.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Unitronics Vision PLC and HMI Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Unitronics Vision Series PLCs and HMIs ship with an insecure default password, which if left unchanged, can allow attackers to execute remote commands.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain a memory corruption vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: MinIO Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: MinIO contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to use crafted requests to bypass metadata bucket name checking and put an object into any bucket while processing `PostPolicyBucket` to conduct privilege escalation. To carry out this attack, the attacker requires credentials with `arn:aws:s3:::*` permission, as well as enabled Console API access.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Sandbox Escape Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Safari WebKit contain an unspecified vulnerability that can allow a remote attacker to break out of the Web Content sandbox. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Safari WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Polkit Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Red Hat Polkit contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability through the bypassing of credential checks for D-Bus requests, allowing for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins User Interface (UI) Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Jenkins User Interface (UI) contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows users to see the names of jobs and builds otherwise inaccessible to them on the "Fingerprints" pages.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chrome Skia Integer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium Skia contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, MacOS, Safari and iPadOS WebKit contain a type confusion vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS contains a type confusion vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content leading to code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium Mojo Insufficient Data Validation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium Mojo contains an insufficient data validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS and macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution when processing malicious crafted web content.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple macOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Apex One OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One Management Console (on-premise) contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated remote attacker to upload malicious code and execute commands on affected installations.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Integer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS. iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an integer overflow vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute code via license services.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

movers7d.product: VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools Privilege Defined with Unsafe Actions Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools contain a privilege defined with unsafe actions vulnerability. A malicious local actor with non-administrative privileges having access to a VM with VMware Tools installed and managed by Aria Operations with SDMP enabled may exploit this vulnerability to escalate privileges to root on the same VM.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Desktop Windows Manager contains a type confusion vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sophos SFOS SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

movers7d.product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: JetBrains TeamCity Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: JetBrains TeamCity contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow limited admin actions to be performed.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized and unauthenticated access. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2024-55550, which allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read arbitrary files on the server.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: CyberPanel Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands as root.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Quantum Security Gateways Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Check Point Quantum Security Gateways contain an unspecified information disclosure vulnerability. The vulnerability potentially allows an attacker to access information on Gateways connected to the internet, with IPSec VPN, Remote Access VPN or Mobile Access enabled. This issue affects several product lines from Check Point, including CloudGuard Network, Quantum Scalable Chassis, Quantum Security Gateways, and Quantum Spark Appliances.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution via a specially crafted request.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bound Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS contains an out-of-bound write vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute code or commands via specifically crafted requests.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Kaseya VSA SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: ConnectWise ManagedITSync integration for Kaseya VSA is vulnerable to unauthenticated remote commands that allow full direct access to the Kaseya VSA database.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DNS-320 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The login_mgr.cgi script in D-Link DNS-320 is vulnerable to remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: DotNetNuke (DNN) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: DotNetNuke (DNN) contains a vulnerability that may allow for remote code execution via cookie deserialization.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA) Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA) contains an information disclosure vulnerability allowing an attacker to obtain the sessionId that can be used to execute further attacks against the system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Server Message Block (SMBv1) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware ESXi OpenSLP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations via the SecurityRequestFilter class.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network. Successfully exploitation could allow an attacker to view sensitive information and make some changes to disclosed information. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-49704. CVE-2025-53771 is a patch bypass for CVE-2025-49706, and the updates for CVE-2025-53771 include more robust protection than those for CVE-2025-49706.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Management Interface OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation through the web-based management interface for several PAN products, including firewalls and VPN concentrators.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Veritas Backup Exec Agent Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the BE Agent via SHA authentication scheme.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. This vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082, which allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Internet Explorer allows remote attackers to execute remote code via a crafted web site that triggers access to a deleted object.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows VBScript Engine Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the VBScript engine handles objects in memory, aka "Windows VBScript Engine Remote Code Execution"

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for security feature bypass.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiSandbox OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiSandbox contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Splunk Enterprise Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

newest.vulnerabilityName: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

newest.product: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.
